note: Organization Setup → Certificate-linked Deductions (owner, 13 Oct). A deduction (e.g. DRA / PCC) is taken every month by its Salary Structure rule — calculation 'Employee Status', on the certificate's status field — while the certificate is pending. When the employee's status reads one of `cleared_values`, the NEXT payroll pays back everything held so far as one earning line (`refund_code`). Held and refunded are read from the closed payrolls, never marked, so a regenerated month is identical and nothing is paid twice. `on_exit`: 'refund' pays the balance in the employee's last payroll; 'forfeit' keeps it and says so on the payslip. Rules ship OFF; the organisation turns each on and saves. Saved versions live in the tenant's Customisation under `customisation_key`.
